title: (Samāpatti-Sātaccakārī)
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Cattāro me bhikkhave jhāyī || || Katame cattāro || || 4-7 Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī || || [catukoṭikaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ] || samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ sākaccakārī ca || || 8-9 Tatra || pa || pavaro cāti ||
